title: Pointed triple window census (Theorem W3) is reconstructible
statement_en: Theorem W3 (pointed triple window, t2.md section 5 of the dominating-edge residual directory): every graph G on at least 3 vertices with distinct u, v, w such that (W) the triples (x, y, z) of distinct vertices with G − x − y ≅ G − u − v by an isomorphism mapping z to w, with deg x in {deg v − [u~v], deg v − [u~v] + 1}, and such that (G − x; y, z) is not doubly-pointed isomorphic to (G − y'; x', z') for any (x', y', z') doubly-pointed equivalent to (u, v, w), are fewer than the triples (x, y, z) with (G − x; y, z) ≅ (G − u; v, w) (an isomorphism G − x → G − u mapping y to v and z to w); and (K) for every such triple (x, y, z) and every automorphism g of G − x − y fixing z, either g preserves adjacency to x or g preserves G-degrees; is reconstructible.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => ∃ u v w : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ u ≠ w ∧ v ≠ w ∧ {p : Fin n × Fin n × Fin n | p.1 ≠ p.2.1 ∧ p.1 ≠ p.2.2 ∧ p.2.1 ≠ p.2.2 ∧ (∃ e : G.induce ({p.1, p.2.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ t : ({p.1, p.2.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), t.1 = p.2.2 → (e t).1 = w) ∧ (G.Adj u v → ((G.neighborSet p.1).ncard + 1 = (G.neighborSet v).ncard ∨ (G.neighborSet p.1).ncard = (G.neighborSet v).ncard)) ∧ (¬ G.Adj u v → ((G.neighborSet p.1).ncard = (G.neighborSet v).ncard ∨ (G.neighborSet p.1).ncard = (G.neighborSet v).ncard + 1)) ∧ ¬ ∃ x' y' z' : Fin n, (x' ≠ y' ∧ x' ≠ z' ∧ y' ≠ z' ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({x'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ t : ({x'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (t.1 = y' → (e t).1 = v) ∧ (t.1 = z' → (e t).1 = w)) ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({y'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ t : ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (t.1 = p.2.1 → (e t).1 = x') ∧ (t.1 = p.2.2 → (e t).1 = z')}.ncard < {p : Fin n × Fin n × Fin n | p.1 ≠ p.2.1 ∧ p.1 ≠ p.2.2 ∧ p.2.1 ≠ p.2.2 ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ t : ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (t.1 = p.2.1 → (e t).1 = v) ∧ (t.1 = p.2.2 → (e t).1 = w)}.ncard ∧ ∀ x y z : Fin n, (x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ t : ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (t.1 = y → (e t).1 = v) ∧ (t.1 = z → (e t).1 = w)) → ∀ g : G.induce ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (∀ t : ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), t.1 = z → (g t).1 = z) → (∀ t : ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj x (g t).1 ↔ G.Adj x t.1) ∨ (∀ t : ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (G.neighborSet (g t).1).ncard = (G.neighborSet t.1).ncard))
